# E0701: address that names no part

An edit replaces a declaration or a body in the program's own files. Find the path with `stilt show`. Nothing was written.

- Rule: [`edits.refusals`](../../reference/19-tools.md#edits.refusals)
- Reported at: the path of the address, in the command line.
- Tier: `core`, checked in the `refusal` phase

## What the compiler prints

The program [`E0701_misspelled_name.lt`](../../tests/diagnostics/E0701_misspelled_name.lt):

`E0701_misspelled_name.lt`:

```stilt fragment
/// Totals what the orders sold.
fn totals(orders: List<i64>) -> i64 {
  var sum = 0
  for qty in orders {
    sum += qty
  }
  sum
}
```

`E0701_misspelled_name.edits`, beside it:

```text
main.total/body#45bc
{ orders.len() }
```

What `stilt check` prints for it:

```text
── ADDRESS THAT NAMES NO PART ──────────────────────────── command line  [E0701]

The program has no part `main.total/body`:

  --edit 'main.total/body#45bc' '{ orders.len() }'
          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^

An edit replaces a declaration or a body in the program's own files. Find the
path with `stilt show`. Nothing was written.

To fix it, address `main.totals`, the closest name:

  --edit 'main.totals/body#45bc' '{ orders.len() }'
          ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```
